engineBranchAtWritingTime: origin/web-codemod-engine at 922c5830 contained only a skeleton README when these fixtures were written; no CLI or transform contract existed to align with. Fixtures follow the wave 3 plan and the V1-05 design.
comparison: Semantic (AST) comparison, not byte comparison. Quote style, semicolons, whitespace, import statement merging/splitting, and binding order are insignificant. Adapter names, method names, type names, call sites, and arguments are significant. See README.md.

Mesin wajib membedakan pemakaian tipe dan pemakaian nilai: berkas yang memakai BaseDirectory.AppData sebagai nilai wajib mendapat import nilai (lihat g1-fs-static), dan berkas campuran wajib dipecah menjadi import nilai + import type.
